name: Arauzo de Salce (Spain)
description: Square flag of three horizontal stripes of green, yellow and blue in the proportions 1:2:1, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Arauzo de Salce (a tree above waves and a sun on yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Arauzo de Salce; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Arauzo de Salce arms — tree above waves and sun
